title: Rainlit bronze, celadon and ceramic lamp

design.authority: design refined from the retained 06 bronze/ceramic concept per .superpowers/assets/rainlit-frame-concepts/selection.md

source.alpha_authority: none embedded; honest alpha is derived here by semantic segmentation (material vs opening/background) and, for the corners, replaced by the square native L-mask
source.note: the approved master is RGB without an alpha channel; the transparent client opening is authored here, not extracted

measured_geometry_px.note: measured from the master by radial inner-edge detection and directional scans; NOT certified masks

inner_corner_rounding.note: the source painterly master rounds the inner opening at the corners; the inner contour measured by radial rays pulls away from the square corner especially at top-right and bottom-right
inner_corner_rounding.corner_repair: the square native L-mask (26 logical arm) is forced; the rounded fillet and any dark pocket inside the material are filled by edge-extension inpainting from real adjacent material, never by a dark liner or padding

atlas.alpha: straight RGBA; RGB zeroed exactly where alpha is zero; transparent gutters

logical_contract.anchor_semantics: anchor is a frame-corner point; tl=(0,0), tr=(rootWidth,0), bl=(0,rootHeight), br=(rootWidth,rootHeight); offset translates the layer top-left from that point (+x right, +y down, no automatic size subtraction); pivot is a local logical point from the layer top-left; angle is radians
logical_contract.emission_semantics: the emission channel is an RGB light gain around 1.0 that preserves the overlay mask alpha; overlay cells carry the real region alpha of the lit apertures / material sheen, never a full rectangle
logical_contract.unused_atlas_space: ignored by the renderer; only the referenced rail/corner/layer cells are drawn

pendant_hook.role: fixed patinated bracket that the paper pendant hangs from

pendant.role: left paper pendant with its cord, pivots about the cord attachment

lamp.role: celadon ceramic lamp on its existing mount, fixed; the sculpture neither swings nor breathes

lamp_slits.role: emissive overlay: the three real lit apertures of the lamp

lamp_sheen.role: weak local warm reflection on the celadon and nearby bronze

lamp_apertures.note: measured amber-lit apertures of the ceramic lamp; each carries its own relative gain so one lamp drives three apertures of different brightness rather than three unrelated lights
lamp_apertures.measurement: warmth(R-B)>=70 and luminance>=130 within the lamp crop; at that threshold the two celadon ribs keep the three apertures separate (a looser threshold merges them into one blob)

provenance.resampling: each cell is resized from its measured source span; rails are cross-faded at their longitudinal endpoints so the repeating tile is seamless; ornament art is scaled isotropically at 1.78 source px per logical px
provenance.originals_preserved: the approved master is retained unchanged in .superpowers/assets/rainlit-frame-concepts/ and copied here byte-identically

not_claimed: no embedded alpha existed in the master; derived alpha is a segmentation result and visual correctness is unverified
native render, joins, seams, alpha, hit-testing, adaptive sizing and reduced-motion are unverified
the lamp aperture count and per-aperture gains are measurements of the painterly master, not a claim about any real lamp
